Q

QUOTE_IN_REFERENCE - Static variable in class p.Widget
A double quote in a reference must be escaped in the Emacs Lisp output.
BACKSLASH_IN_REFERENCE - Static variable in class p.Widget
A backslash in a reference must be escaped in the Emacs Lisp output, so that Emacs reads the reference as "file:api/p/Wi\dget.html#BACKSLASH".
